create_DDIMInverseScheduler: create a DDIMInverseScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and prediction type for image inversion
call_step_inverse: call the step method on DDIMInverseScheduler to compute the previous sample from model output and timestep
call_set_timesteps: call set_timesteps on DDIMInverseScheduler to configure discrete timesteps for a given number of inference steps
create_betas_for_alpha_bar: create a beta schedule tensor using betas_for_alpha_bar with cosine, exp, or laplace transform types
rescale_zero_terminal_snr: rescale betas to have zero terminal SNR using rescale_zero_terminal_snr for brighter and darker sample generation
